messages:
maria: Heads-up — product plans to GA 'sparrow' next Tues. Early traffic sim shows a sustained +60% token/sec on hosted inference for the first 72h. Need capacity recommendations and quick mitigations.
lee: Can you paste the sim numbers? region split?
maria: Sure — we ran workload replay from last quarter and added 3M new users from the marketing plan. Rough high-level: baseline hosted tokens/sec = 28k across fleet. Sparrow increases that to ~45k tokens/sec peak, sustained 30k+ for 72h. Peak concurrency hits ~9k active streams. Mostly us-west (65%), eu-west (20%), apac (15%).
nina: Oof. What's per-token cost / GPUs per token for sparrow? Any quantized variant?
maria: Model is a new 16B variant. Perf numbers from bench: ~1.6 tokens/sec per A100-40 for decoding at typical prompt lengths (50 tokens avg). With KV caching and batching we can bump to ~2.4 t/s on A100-80 (experimental). There's a smaller 6B quantized fallback but quality gap is noticeable.
sam: Quick calc: to sustain 45k t/s we'd need 45,000 / 2.4 ~= 18.75 -> ~19 A100-80s for steady peak. But that's optimistic; real-world has tail effects. For safety I'd double to ~38 GPUs with headroom for autoscaling.
lee: Convert to GPU-hours for billing: 38 GPUs * 24h/day * 3 days = 2,736 GPU-hours for the 72h window.
maria: Product is expecting spikes beyond that during the press window. Add 20% buffer and we hit ~3,283 GPU-hours. Cost estimate: ~A100-80 spot avg $2.8/hr -> host cost ~ $9.2k for the surge (spots vary), or $13.7k on on-demand.
nina: Region-specific constraints: eu-west quota is tight — we only have 8 A100-80 reserved there. apac only 6. We'd have to route non-APAC traffic to us-west or use smaller instances.
sam: Suggestion: staged rollout by region + pre-warm US pools. Also enable model routing: serve 90% traffic on quantized 6B in APAC/Europe then fallback to 16B for high-quality requests. Could use quality header from product to decide.
lee: Autoscaler notes: cooldown and burst settings currently: min_replicas=10, max_replicas=120, scale_step=10, cooldown_secs=180. For this launch we should lower cooldown to 60s and increase scale_step to 20 to react quicker. Also pre-warm replicas 4h before launch.
maria: Can deploy-bot create a pre-warm runbook?
deploy-bot: runbook created: prewarm/sparrow-2027-01. Steps: 1) increase min_replicas to 40 for us-west 2) set cooldown_secs=60 3) set routing policy -> prefer us-west, degrade to 6B in eu/apac 4) enable kv-cache priming job 2h before 5) monitor token/s and p95 latency.
nina: Network gotcha — last time we hit ephemeral socket exhaustion in us-west when we doubled streams. Recommend bumping per-node ephemeral port pool and checking NAT gateway limits. Also verify egress quota for eu-west third-party telemetry (it caps at 1.2 Gbps currently).
sam: Ops checklist: 1) request eu-west quota bump from cloud (8 -> 20 A100-80) — started ticket CT-4321. 2) Spin up a prewarm batch of 20 quantized pods in eu and apac to handle tail. 3) Add canary rollout: 5% traffic to sparrow 16B for 6h. 4) Enable autoscaler aggressive mode for 8h post-GA.
lee: If cloud quota doesn't land, plan B: migrate some EU traffic to our dedicated backbone in us-west (will increase latency ~40–70ms), inform product.
maria: Also recommended: reduce max_tokens default in hosted API for first 48h (from 1024 -> 512) to reduce t/s load. Product OK with that as temporary opt-in.
sam: Quick script to compute GPUs needed from tokens/sec: ```python
def gpus_needed(tokens_per_sec, eff_tps_per_gpu=2.4):
    return int(math.ceil(tokens_per_sec / eff_tps_per_gpu * 1.4))  # 40% safety
```
lee: That 40% safety factor matches our ops playbook. Using that we get: for 45k t/s -> gpus = ceil(45000/2.4*1.4)= 26 GPUs steady -> with burst headroom -> request 40.
nina: Logging/alerts: create temporary alert thresholds: token_surge > 35k for 15m, queue_len > 200 for 5m, p95_latency > 800ms for 10m. Tie alerts to oncall and product pager.
maria: Who owns the KV-cache priming job?
sam: I'll own it. Plan: run synthetic generator that replays top-10k prefixes to warm caches. Cost ~ 120 GPU-hours for priming.
lee: Final ask: confirm numbers with finance for cost center allocation. I'll send estimated invoice for surge to product.
maria: Thanks — I'll update the launch doc and schedule two dry-runs this week. If anyone spots other failure modes call them out here. :thumbsup:
sam: Noted. Will push autoscaler changes to staging now.
lee: I'll follow up on CT-4321 and NAT checks.
nina: I'll open the alert PR and set up runbook links.
maria: Great, closing for now. We reconvene tomorrow after the dry-run. :calendar:
